resolved_findings.finding: Trust, appeal, report and reconsideration failures could surface raw backend strings in safety-sensitive UI.
resolved_findings.resolution: Stable localized errors replace raw detail in every bounded safety mutation and read state.

resolved_findings.finding: Backend-provided label meanings were rendered directly and were Romanian-only.
resolved_findings.resolution: Known machine codes map to controlled localized explanations; unknown codes receive a generic non-verdict message.

resolved_findings.finding: Malformed or incomplete Trust assessments could cause fragile or ambiguous UI.
resolved_findings.resolution: Assessment objects and label arrays are checked and explicit unavailable fallbacks fail closed.

resolved_findings.finding: Report categories and reconsideration states mixed Romanian literals into other locales.
resolved_findings.resolution: RO, EN, PL and AR catalogue parity covers every bounded report and review state.

resolved_findings.finding: Dynamic moderation identifiers could reorder under Arabic UI.
resolved_findings.resolution: Machine codes and status identifiers are escaped and isolated as LTR runs.

capacity.observed_evidence: Capacity indicator is not programmatically observable in this run; the separate worker remains usage-limited.
